# LabelNest

> LabelNest is a data systems and intelligence company based in Bengaluru, India. It builds
> and operates two products: NestLens, a private markets operating system for emerging fund
> managers and analysts, and NestHR, an HR and campus-placement operating system for startups
> and colleges. Founder and Director: Ankit Suman.

## Products

- [NestLens](https://labelnest.in/nestlens): Private markets OS with six modules, each also a
  live satellite subdomain — [Atlas](https://labelnest.in/nestlens/intelligence)
  (atlas.labelnest.in — structured intelligence on 40,000+ private market entities: companies,
  funds, GPs, LPs, deals, contacts), [Exchange](https://labelnest.in/nestlens/exchange)
  (exchange.labelnest.in — marketplace for buying/selling structured datasets, AI training data,
  and research, KYC-verified sellers, escrow protection), [Ascent](https://labelnest.in/nestlens/capital)
  (ascent.labelnest.in — investor-ready data room builder, LP-GP matching, for pre-seed to Series A
  startups), [Command](https://labelnest.in/nestlens/command) (command.labelnest.in — fund-side
  operating system: fund dashboard, LP management, portfolio tracking, deal sourcing, IC voting),
  [Connect](https://labelnest.in/nestlens/connect) (connect.labelnest.in — mentor connect and
  verified audit partners), and [Orbit](https://labelnest.in/nestlens/orbit) (orbit.labelnest.in —
  programme management for accelerators/incubators: application intake, screening, evaluation,
  cohort onboarding). Credit-based access, no lock-in. Hub at nestlens.labelnest.in.
- [NestLens vs Preqin](https://labelnest.in/vs/preqin)
- [NestLens vs PitchBook](https://labelnest.in/vs/pitchbook)
- [NestLens vs DocSend](https://labelnest.in/vs/docsend)
- [NestLens vs Carta](https://labelnest.in/vs/carta)
- [NestHR](https://labelnest.in/nesthr): HR and placement OS with 7 modules — People, Talent OS /
  PlacementOS (its flagship module, built for campus recruitment and startup hiring, improves
  shortlisting accuracy from every selection/rejection signal), Performance, Expense, Learning,
  Analytics, Admin. INR pricing, built for India. Live at nesthr.labelnest.in.
